Given the gridded visibility data, it performs correlation using \sphinxstylestrong{Cross TGE} estimator which is defined as follows :
\begin{equation*}
\begin{split}\text{corr}(\nu_a,\nu_b) = \mathcal{R}e\left[\mathcal{V}_{cg}^{\rm RR}(\nu_a) \mathcal{V}_{cg}^{*\rm LL}(\nu_b) + \mathcal{V}_{cg}^{\rm LL}(\nu_a) \mathcal{V}_{cg}^{*\rm RR}(\nu_b) \right]\end{split}
\end{equation*}\begin{quote}\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{Parameters}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{GV}} (\sphinxstyleliteralemphasis{\sphinxupquote{np.ndarray}}) \textendash{} Convolved gridded visibility array (3D array) \(\mathcal{V}_{cg}(\nu_n)^{XX/YY}\). \sphinxstylestrong{GV} structure is (Polarization, Grid points, Frequency).

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{ni}} (\sphinxstyleliteralemphasis{\sphinxupquote{np.ndarray}}) \textendash{} 1D array containing the info about which grid point falls into which annular bin. Must contain values in between \(0,\textrm{Nbin}-1\).

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{Nbin}} (\sphinxstyleliteralemphasis{\sphinxupquote{int}}) \textendash{} No of annular bins the whole \(uv\) plane has been divided into.

\end{itemize}

\sphinxlineitem{Returns}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{corr} \textendash{} 3D array of shape (Nbin, NC, NC).

\sphinxlineitem{Return type}
\sphinxAtStartPar
np.ndarray

\begin{fulllineitems}
\phantomsection\label{\detokenize{correlate:correlate.correlate}}
\pysigstartsignatures
\pysiglinewithargsret{\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{correlate.}}\sphinxbfcode{\sphinxupquote{correlate}}}{\sphinxparam{\DUrole{n}{GV}}\sphinxparamcomma \sphinxparam{\DUrole{n}{ni}}\sphinxparamcomma \sphinxparam{\DUrole{n}{Nbin}}}{}
\pysigstopsignatures
\sphinxAtStartPar
Given the gridded visibility data, it performs correlation using \sphinxstylestrong{Cross TGE} estimator which is defined as follows :
\begin{equation*}
\begin{split}\text{corr}(\nu_a,\nu_b) = \mathcal{R}e\left[\mathcal{V}_{cg}^{\rm RR}(\nu_a) \mathcal{V}_{cg}^{*\rm LL}(\nu_b) + \mathcal{V}_{cg}^{\rm LL}(\nu_a) \mathcal{V}_{cg}^{*\rm RR}(\nu_b) \right]\end{split}
\end{equation*}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Then it collapses the frequency axis to get \(\text{corr}(\Delta\nu)\).
\begin{quote}\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{Parameters}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{GV}} (\sphinxstyleliteralemphasis{\sphinxupquote{np.ndarray}}) \textendash{} Convolved gridded visibility array (3D array) \(\mathcal{V}_{cg}(\nu_n)^{XX/YY}\). \sphinxstylestrong{GV} structure is (Polarization, Grid points, Frequency).

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{ni}} (\sphinxstyleliteralemphasis{\sphinxupquote{np.ndarray}}) \textendash{} 1D array containing the info about which grid point falls into which annular bin. Must contain values in between \(0,\textrm{Nbin}-1\).

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{Nbin}} (\sphinxstyleliteralemphasis{\sphinxupquote{int}}) \textendash{} No of annular bins the whole \(uv\) plane has been divided into.

\end{itemize}

\sphinxlineitem{Returns}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{corr} \textendash{} 2D array of shape (Nbin, NC).

\sphinxlineitem{Return type}
\sphinxAtStartPar
np.ndarray

\end{description}\end{quote}
